text: じゃくてんを…　つくまえに　やられたあ

structure.jp: じゃくてんを…　つくまえに

patterns.name: 〜まえに
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus まえに means 'before doing'. つくまえに = 'before I could hit it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb form says the thing was done to the speaker. The long あ is a cry. やられたあ = 'I got beaten!'
